Hi Suresh — thanks for the context and the attachment. I'm happy to run the sizing call on Wed Jul 7 at 10:00am PT. A couple items that will help me prepare and make the session concrete:

1) Expected peak QPS and sustained QPS windows (if you have 1-hour peaks vs 10-minute bursts, please indicate).
2) Avg tokens per request and 90/95th percentile token sizes (we'll use this to estimate KV cache and GPU memory).
3) Target p95 latency: is this user-perceived (end-to-end) or inference-only? If end-to-end, please share typical network latency between your front-end and our region.
4) Any model variants or sequence lengths you expect (e.g., retrieval+generation with 1–2k tokens).

I've attached a short capacity template you can fill quickly — it helps map tokens/qps to GPU counts and expected latencies.

Attachment: redwood_dedicated_capacity_template.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to it.
